description: This file is a script for analyzing Vitest test report files to identify the slowest test files based on duration. It imports utility functions, processes command line arguments, loads a report, and outputs the top hotspots.

methods.name: formatMs
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a human-readable string.

methods.name: loadVitestReportFromArgs
methods.description: Loads a Vitest report based on command line arguments.

methods.name: parseVitestReportArgs
methods.description: Parses command line arguments to extract options for report generation.

methods.name: collectVitestFileDurations
methods.description: Extracts file duration statistics from a Vitest report.
